__doc__: SRCSM (SemRandConv-3D) faithful augmentation recipe, wired through AugLab's GPU/Kornia path (nnUNetTrainerDAExtGPU) for backbone parity with PALETTE. Reproduces Thaler et al. IEEE Access 2025 (github.com/imigraz/SRCSM_Domain_Generalization) MR training recipe. This ONE config is shared across all datasets: num_labels is null here and is filled in per dataset by nnUNetTrainerDAExtGPU from the nnU-Net label_manager (= background + #foreground task classes: CHAOS/BraTS=5, ON-Harmony=32, open-ms=2). A non-null value here would override that. See __notes__.

__notes__.rcnet_p1: SRCSM applies RCNet every training step (main.py train_step calls get_new_randnet_model_image unconditionally) => probability=1.0. per_label+smoothing = their use_randnet_per_label + use_randnet_per_label_smoothing defaults for MR.
__notes__.intensity: SRCSM's ONLY intensity augmentation is ShiftScaleClamp(random_shift=0.2, random_scale=0.4, clamp_min=-1, clamp_max=None), reproduced INSIDE SemRandConvGPU (robust-normalise -> ShiftScaleClamp -> RCNet). No generic AugLab intensity transforms (Gamma/Brightness/Contrast/Noise/Blur) are added, because SRCSM uses none. This is intentional and faithful.
__notes__.normalisation: SemRandConvGPU re-derives SRCSM's normalize_robust [-1,1] domain internally (domain-invariant because RCNet is positive-homogeneous degree-1) and ends with a foreground z-score so output matches the nnU-Net backbone input domain. This gives true backbone parity with PALETTE without altering RCNet texture.
__notes__.spatial_rotation: EXACT: SRCSM rotation.Random([0.35,0.35,0.35]) rad = +-20.05 deg/axis, mapped to GPU AffineTransform degrees=20.05 (RandomAffine3DCustom interprets degrees in degrees; a scalar => yaw/pitch/roll each from (-d,+d)).
__notes__.spatial_scale: APPROX: SRCSM composes scale.RandomUniform(0.2) [isotropic 1+U(-0.2,0.2)] with scale.Random([0.1,0.1,0.1]) [per-axis 1+U(-0.1,0.1)]; net per-axis range ~[0.72,1.32]. RandomAffine3DCustom samples one uniform per axis over [0.72,1.32], which matches the support but not the exact product-of-two-uniforms density.
__notes__.spatial_translation: APPROX: SRCSM translation.Random([20,20,20]) is +-20 mm in PHYSICAL space; RandomAffine3DCustom translate is a fraction of patch size. 0.125 assumes ~1mm spacing and ~160-voxel patch (20/160). Adjust per dataset spacing/patch if exact mm matching is required.
__notes__.spatial_elastic: APPROX: SRCSM deformation.Output(grid=[8,8,8], magnitude=15) is an MDAT b-spline field; AugLab exposes only p_elastic_deform on the CPU batchgeneratorsv2 SpatialTransform, whose elastic magnitude/scale use batchgeneratorsv2 defaults (NOT SRCSM's mag=15). Enabled at p=1.0 as the closest available approximation. This is the primary irreducible harness gap in the faithful mapping.
__notes__.spatial_split: Rotation+translation+scale run on the GPU AffineTransform (config-exact ranges); elastic runs on the CPU SpatialTransform (only elastic mechanism available). Rotation is forced onto GPU because the CPU SpatialTransform rotation range is locked to nnU-Net's dataset default (rotation_for_DA), not settable to +-0.35 rad. Two resamples (CPU elastic + GPU affine) vs SRCSM's single composed sitk resample is a minor interpolation-smoothing difference.
__notes__.mirroring: SRCSM uses NO flipping; AugLab GPU trainer force-disables mirroring. No FlipTransform block, consistent with both.
__notes__.num_labels_per_dataset: CHAOS-MR: 5 (bg+liver+Rkidney+Lkidney+spleen). Set to bg+#foreground-classes for each benchmark (AMOS 4-organ subset: 5; BraTS-2024: bg+tumour-subregions; open-ms: bg+lesion=2). num_labels must include background and match the SRCSM train script's num_labels for that task.
